verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for any software product, including a SaaS meeting notetaker, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a public repository, published source code, or an open-source license. The docs cover a proprietary GraphQL API, an MCP server, and llms.txt, none of which make the product's own source readable. One community comment contrasts Fireflies with an open-source notetaker, which suggests it is not open source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
